abilities.desc_zh: 远程重火器发射高温热核弹，击中必定引发燃烧 (Burn)，持续造成火热伤害并阻止敌方任何生命恢复。
abilities.desc_en: Fires thermonuclear incendiary rounds, inflicting Burn that deals continuous damage and completely nullifies enemy Healing/Regen.

abilities.desc_zh: 敌人处于燃烧状态时，新星风对其造成的暴击伤害提升 50%；重击引爆燃烧层数造成巨额范围爆炸。
abilities.desc_en: Deals +50% Critical Damage against Burning targets. Heavy Attacks detonate Burn stacks into a catastrophic explosion.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次爆炸命中都会叠加一层聚变反应堆能量，叠满 5 层后下一次特殊技威力提升 120% 且必定暴击破防！
abilities.desc_en: Explosions stack Fusion charges. At 5 stacks, next Special Attack deals +120% damage with unblockable Critical strikes!

abilities.desc_zh: 瞬发微型集束导弹齐射，击碎敌方格挡并施加破甲，降低敌方 {{var_1}} 护甲持续 {{var_2}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Fires cluster micro-missiles, breaking block and reducing Armor by {{var_1}} for {{var_2}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 投掷凝固汽油热核炸弹点燃战场，施加燃烧并在 {{var_3}} 秒内造成 {{var_4}} 火焰伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Drops napalm thermonuclear payloads, inflicting Burn dealing {{var_4}} Fire damage over {{var_3}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 超高音速俯冲战术核爆，造成热核辐射灼烧，在 {{var_5}} 秒内造成 {{var_6}} 伤害，并摧毁对手 {{var_7}} 能量。
abilities.desc_en: Detonates a tactical nuclear bomb, dealing {{var_6}} radiation damage over {{var_5}}s and draining {{var_7}} Power.

abilities.desc_zh: 与酸雨、离子风同队时，全队元素减益持续时间延长 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: Elemental debuffs last {{var_1}} longer when teamed with Acid Storm and Ion Storm.

abilities.desc_zh: 与电影铁皮、搅拌者同队时，暴击率提升 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Critical Rating when teamed with Ironhide or Mixmaster.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 爆炸伤害。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Explosive Damage.
